name: Ultimate Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator
author: Belov

sections.description:
Ultimate Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator is the most comprehensive and user-friendly tool for tracking pregnancy milestones and ovulation dates on your WordPress website. It is perfect for health blogs, parenting sites, women’s wellness platforms, and family planning websites.

This versatile calculator offers two main calculation modes:

PREGNANCY CALCULATOR

Calculate important pregnancy dates with multiple calculation methods:
* Due Date Calculator – Estimate due date based on the last menstrual period.
* Last Period Calculator – Calculate the last period date from the estimated due date.
* Conception Date Calculator – Find out the conception date and other key pregnancy milestones.
* Ultrasound Due Date Calculator – Determine due dates using ultrasound measurements.
* IVF Pregnancy Calculator – Special calculations for pregnancies conceived via IVF.

OVULATION CALCULATOR

Track fertility windows and ovulation dates to support family planning.

KEY FEATURES

  • Two Calculation Modes – Switch between Pregnancy and Ovulation calculators.
  • Flexible Date Formats – Display dates in formats like MM/DD/YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY.
  • Customizable Design – Match the calculator’s appearance with your website’s style using the built-in color picker.
  • Responsive Design – Optimized for all devices, ensuring a seamless experience on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • Easy Integration – Add the calculator to any page or post using a simple shortcode: [ultimate-pregnancy-ovulation].
  • User-Friendly Interface – Intuitive and engaging design for an excellent user experience.

PRO VERSION – COMING SOON!

Get ready for the Pro Version of Ultimate Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator with advanced features, marketing integrations, and enhanced data management!

What’s Coming:
* All Five Calculation Methods – Unlock full flexibility for pregnancy tracking.
* Marketing Integrations – Connect with:
* ConvertKit – Collect emails and send campaigns.
* HubSpot – Boost marketing strategies.
* Make – Automate workflows.
* Advanced Data Management –
* CSV Export – For analysis and record-keeping.
* PDF Results – Downloadable for offline use.
* Email Results – Send detailed calculations to users.

Stay tuned! Pro Version is coming soon!

WHO IS THIS PLUGIN FOR?

  • Health and Wellness Websites – Provide valuable tools for pregnancy and ovulation tracking.
  • Parenting Blogs – Enhance content with helpful pregnancy planning tools.
  • Family Planning Websites – Support users on their journey to parenthood.
  • Medical Information Sites – Offer accurate and reliable pregnancy and ovulation calculations.

Try the Ultimate Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator today and provide your visitors with a helpful family planning tool!

TRANSLATIONS

  • English: default, always included.
  • Your language: Coming soon!

Note: The plugin is localized/translateable by default. This is very important for all users worldwide. So please contribute your language to the plugin to make it even more useful. For translating, please use the POT file, which is always included in the plugin’s languages folder.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ultimate-pregnancy-ovulation-calculator directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Dashboard -> Ultimate Pregnancy to configure the plugin settings.
  4. Use the shortcode [ultimate_pregnancy_ovulation] on any page or post where you want the calculator to appear.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the colors of the calculator?

Yes! You can use the built-in color picker in the plugin settings to match your website’s design.

Can I display both calculators on the same page?

Currently, only one calculator type can be displayed at a time, selectable in the plugin settings.

How accurate are the calculations?

The calculator uses standard medical formulas for pregnancy and ovulation calculations. Please note that these are estimates. For medical advice, always consult with a healthcare professional.

Can I change the date format?

Yes, you can select your preferred date format in the plugin settings.
sections.changelog:
1.1.5

  • Updated gulp POT generation to use active text domain so translations populate correctly.

1.1.4

  • Optimized frontend assets for improved performance.

1.1.3

  • Fixed baby-born template display issue when due date is in full weeks.

1.1.2

  • Changed text label from ‘days until meeting’ to ‘days until birth’ for better clarity.
  • Resolved a style conflict with third-party themes that caused the color of the tag to display incorrectly.

1.1.1

  • Resolved a style conflict with third-party plugins that caused the datepicker calendar to display incorrectly.

1.1.0

  • Resolved an issue where pregnancy term calculations could change mid-day due to timezone differences. Date calculations are now consistently based on midnight for more accurate and stable results.
  • Tested for compatibility with WordPress 6.8.1.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of the Ultimate Pregnancy & Ovulation Calculator.
  • Includes two calculation modes: Pregnancy Calculator and Ovulation Calculator.
  • Customizable design and responsive layout.
  • Easy integration with shortcode.
